'Deal 1 arcane damage to target hero. / Surge - If this deals more than 1 damage, put it on the bottom of its owner's deck.'

Surge (CR 8.4.8) reads the damage this card ACTUALLY dealt -- after Amp, prevention and Arcane Barrier, which are exactly what push it past the printed number -- and tests strictly GREATER THAN, which is how every printed Surge is worded. The DEAL runs first so the gate sees this card's damage rather than a previous card's.

'PUT IT on the bottom' is THIS card, not the damaged hero and not a card in a zone -- PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK. A non-attack action would otherwise go to the graveyard on resolution, so the clause is the card's whole recursion and getting the referent wrong loses it silently.
